_README: Formula One Championship Edition (PS3). Rules for maintaining this table:
1. HASH = crc32(filename.lower()) with poly 0x04c11db7, init 0, finalXOR 0xffffffff.
Case NEVER affects the hash - it is cosmetic, so casing can be corrected freely.
2. NO '' prefix. Unlike the WipEout tables, F1 paths are rooted at the top level
(Animations/, Effects/, HOST_SVML/, Models/). Proven: 393/393 build-log pairs hash
3. FILE ORDER MATTERS - it mirrors the WAD entry order, which is a depth-first walk:
within each directory, files sorted alphabetically (case-insensitive) FIRST, then
subdirectories, recursively. Never reorder this array: the ordering brackets each
unknown entry into a directory and an alphabetical window, which is how unnamed
9 = verbatim from a build log embedded in the WAD (44 entries starting with
'Target Endian is' print 'HASH path' pairs). Ground truth - keep the exact
spelling the log prints, even when inconsistent (e.g. 'wheels.sgskel').
7 = derived: name found in the data or reconstructed, then CRC32-validated.
0 = unresolved placeholder named after its own hash.
5. CASING PRECEDENCE: build-log (confidence 9) spelling wins. For segments the log
never mentions, the variant with more uppercase wins (Local over local).
name: Formula One Championship Edition PS3 (BCES-00005)
